notes: A long run can now be stopped. Cancel on Extraction, Synthesis, Index and the SharePoint download finishes what is already in flight, keeps it, and leaves the rest for the next run. The document converter needed for older Word and PowerPoint files installs itself as a step during setup, with no administrator rights. An updated IRL can be re-read from the same workbook without losing review work: only requests whose wording actually changed go back for review. Two fixes: intake runs are numbered from 1 rather than 0, and very large spreadsheets that would not index now index correctly. The progress line also reads more clearly, with the document on the left and the count and time remaining on the right.
